openingDialogueObserved.speaker: Goddess
openingDialogueObserved.text: MORTALS! You stand before the radiant guardian of this sacred land!

openingDialogueObserved.speaker: Goddess
openingDialogueObserved.text: My glorious hair is MISSING! Vanished from my very own shrine!

openingDialogueObserved.speaker: Coco
openingDialogueObserved.text: Wait. We passed three trials to meet a goddess who lost her wig?

openingDialogueObserved.speaker: Coco
openingDialogueObserved.text: Look, we're not here about your hair. My papa—

openingDialogueObserved.speaker: Goddess
openingDialogueObserved.text: NO QUESTIONS UNTIL MY CROWN OF BEAUTY IS RESTORED!

openingDialogueObserved.speaker: Sieg
openingDialogueObserved.text: Coco, maybe we should just help her.

openingDialogueObserved.speaker: Goddess
openingDialogueObserved.text: At last! Mortals with proper reverence!

openingDialogueObserved.speaker: Quest
openingDialogueObserved.text: New objective: Recover the Divine Wig. No one knows where it went: search the Mirror Pond to the west, the Hedge Maze to the east, and the Griffin Enclosure to the north.
